pins.all.description: Heading of the menu listing every pinned page, and name of the summary that opens it from the row of pins.

pins.confirmRemoveAll.description: Question asked before the pinned pages are all removed, the only destructive action of the row.

pins.countMany.description: Count at the end of the row of pins, for several pages, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

pins.countOne.description: Count at the end of the row of pins, for one page, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser.

pins.filter.description: Placeholder and name of the field filtering the menu of the pinned pages.

pins.label.description: Small capital label opening the row of the pinned pages under the bar.

pins.pages.description: Accessible name of the row of the pinned pages under the bar.

pins.pin.description: Button of the page header that pins the page, while it is not pinned.

pins.pinned.description: The same button, pressed, while the page is pinned; pressing it again unpins the page.

pins.removeAll.description: Button at the foot of the menu of the pinned pages that removes every pin, after confirmation.

pins.unpin.description: Accessible name of the cross removing one pinned page, the quoted placeholder being filled in the browser with the title of the page.
